_comment_paths: Relative to Starter_Kit. Frozen snapshot received 18 Sep 2026; always read-only, scripts writing databases must use a separate working copy. Full imagery XYZ archive and full tile plan remain historical paths.
_comment_sites: A site is a square cell you label exhaustively. 24 sites x ~20 crowns = ~500 crowns.

reference_set._comment_splits: Equal thirds, not the usual 50/20/30. Every stratum must appear in the test split, because one acceptance threshold is per-stratum recall and that has to be measured on held-out data. With 8 strata and 24 sites, equal thirds puts ~20 labelled crowns per stratum in test. That is a wide confidence interval and you should say so in the report; a smaller test split would be worse.

_comment_thresholds: PREDECLARED at M1 (7 Aug 2026). Do not change these after seeing results. If a change is unavoidable, record the date and reason in docs/DECISIONS.md and state it in the report.

acceptance_thresholds.winner_rule: bootstrap 95% CI on F1 improvement over the classical baseline must exclude zero

_comment_baseline: The database is pinned to a frozen snapshot taken 2026-07-30, NOT the live repository database. The live one has since been rebuilt with an NDVI vegetation gate and 233,145 promoted low-canopy trees, which would move reference-site selection and break its reproducibility. Your labels are crown polygons in EPSG:2193 keyed to site geometry, not to tree_id, so they remain valid against any future detection run. Verify the snapshot with scripts/baseline_snapshot.py verify in the source repo. If /Volumes/T7 is not mounted, standalone mode still works: data/sites/cell_aggregate.csv.gz reproduces site selection without the database.
